title: Prompt
description: x-prompt makes a click open a dialog that asks for a line of text, with promptTitle, promptMessage, a placeholder and an optional defaultValue.

heading.description: Dialog heading. Only used when `promptTitle` is absent.

message.description: Body text. Only used when `promptMessage` is absent.

placeholder.description: Placeholder shown in the empty input.

defaultValue.description: Value the input starts with, already selected so typing replaces it.

promptTitle.description: Dialog heading. Read BEFORE `heading`; defaults to `Input`.

promptMessage.description: Body text above the field. Read BEFORE `message`.

_metadata.derivedFrom: the behavior implementation — every property here is one the code actually reads
_metadata.note: Expand by hand: enums, richer descriptions and accessibility notes cannot be read from source.
